_README: Stage-2 hand labels for the M2 gate corpus. INCOMPLETE — see _progress. Each entry records my label, my confidence, and whether the maintainer documented the change in-PR. Rule: where I am confident, my reading stands even if the maintainer did not document (maintainers often skip docs — that is drift, which is the whole premise of the product). Where I am UNCERTAIN, the entry is marked contested and EXCLUDED from the gate, because a noisy answer key is worse than a smaller one. Confidence is recorded per entry so the exclusions are auditable rather than convenient.
